# Baseline UI

A quick pass over typography, spacing, hierarchy and basic interaction. The original prescribes Tailwind, React motion and component primitives; check stack compatibility before applying.

Original files below retain the upstream language and contents. Atlas task notes do not replace the complete skill.

task.en: Review spacing, type hierarchy and interaction consistency using the project’s existing components and constraints.
